project.name: masterminds-workshop
project.description: Masterminds Workshop Site is a Next.js application for event discovery and registration, workshop learning, and giveaway resource distribution, with shared content catalogs, payment integration, and email delivery.

layers.name: API Routes
layers.description: The represented unsubscribe endpoint verifies list-management tokens and records email suppressions.

layers.name: Pages
layers.description: Event listings, workshop details, attendee setup and bonus guides provide the main workshop content and navigation.

layers.name: Giveaway Tools
layers.description: Giveaway pages, SEO layouts, resource packs and reusable prompts present AI tools, quizzes and product guides.

layers.name: Shared Libraries
layers.description: Event and giveaway catalogs, pricing and email helpers, resource contracts and offer definitions support delivery; a lazy Supabase proxy defers client creation until first use.

layers.name: Assets
layers.description: Downloadable resource ZIP archives, integrity checksums and the distributed Desk Pet setup guide supply giveaway delivery assets.

layers.name: Operations
layers.description: The guarded giveaway follow-up runner coordinates external eligibility checks, previews and claimed deliveries using the shared follow-up planner.

layers.name: Tests
layers.description: Catalog, resource pack and follow-up tests protect content contracts, asset integrity, email mappings and suppression behavior, including legacy Video Editor source guarantees.

layers.name: Configuration
layers.description: Next.js tracing, exclusions, host rewrites and legacy redirects configure delivery, including migration of the free Video Editor route and ZIP to the paid Video Agent.

layers.name: UI Components
layers.description: Festival hero and program components, registration controls, ambient media and shared giveaway rendering support the event and resource pages.

tour.title: Project and Event Discovery
tour.description: Start with the main events listing to see the workshop site through a visitor’s eyes: upcoming live events, prices, dates and links to details. This is the represented overview entry in the partial graph; the home page is outside its coverage.

tour.title: Event Data and Registration
tour.description: Follow the listing’s dependency into the shared event catalog, which defines dates, capacities, pricing, promotions and setup content. The dynamic detail and attendee setup pages consume that same catalog, connecting discovery to registration and preparation.
tour.languageLesson: Next.js App Router uses folders such as [slug] for dynamic route parameters, with page.tsx defining the rendered page.

tour.title: Festival Presentation and Attendance Windows
tour.description: The event catalog also feeds the Joechella hero and grouped program timeline. Follow these components to see the full-week celebration link, concurrent activities and the highlighted restriction on morning attendance.

tour.title: Giveaway Catalogs and Discovery
tour.description: Alongside paid events, the site organizes free resources in typed giveaway and free AI tool catalogs. Their lookup helpers centralize resource identity, while the sitemap uses free AI tool slugs to expose those pages to search engines.

tour.title: Resource Packs and Prompts
tour.description: With resource discovery established, examine the LinkedIn Kit’s page, content pack and reusable prompt. The page imports its pack and the pack imports the prompt, illustrating how presentation and instructional content are separated across giveaway resources.
tour.languageLesson: TypeScript content objects let multiple React pages share a rendering contract while keeping each resource’s copy separate.

tour.title: Desk Pet Setup Workflow
tour.description: Desk Pet applies the pack pattern to a Mac app builder guide with setup commands, troubleshooting and downloadable instructions. Its page adds HowTo structured data, while the canonical prompt supplies the instructions that distributed copies must match.

tour.title: Legacy Video Editor and Paid Video Agent Migration
tour.description: The legacy page still defines a shared resource pack and HowTo metadata, and its tests protect the packaged editing workflow. Next.js redirects both the old giveaway route and the free ZIP URL to the paid Video Agent, so the remaining source does not imply a public free download.

tour.title: Distributed Guides and Downloads
tour.description: The public Desk Pet document turns the preceding source prompt into a user-facing setup guide covering personalization, installation and removal. Public ZIP archives deliver other resource kits, and their checksum files provide a separate integrity artifact alongside each download.

tour.title: Quiz Content Variants
tour.description: The same content-driven approach supports quizzes as well as downloadable kits. These thin page wrappers consume packs explaining distinct capability and behavioral scales, then direct visitors to quizzes hosted outside this application.

tour.title: Email Delivery and Unsubscribe
tour.description: After visitors choose a resource, shared email helpers build HTML and plain-text delivery messages and restrict destinations to trusted giveaway links. The represented unsubscribe route verifies list-management tokens and records suppressions, showing the corresponding opt-out boundary. The shared Supabase proxy initializes its client on first access so imports can succeed without production credentials.

tour.title: Guarded Follow-up Operations
tour.description: Beyond initial delivery, the follow-up service plans copy and schedules while applying suppression, timing, human handoff and real-event eligibility rules. Its operational runner combines those plans with external checks and supports previews, dry runs, review delivery and claimed sends.

tour.title: Route Metadata and Configuration
tour.description: The resource journeys also depend on search metadata and routing behavior. Giveaway layouts supply page-specific metadata, while Next.js configuration controls redirects, host rewrites and build tracing for the site’s delivery paths. The configuration also migrates the former Video Editor page and archive to the paid Video Agent.

tour.title: Workshop Learning Resources
tour.description: Return to the learning side of the site after tracing discovery and delivery. Bonus workshop pages and the automated lead magnet guide provide instructional material, while the CLAUDE.md pack illustrates a longer configuration-focused resource using the same content organization.

tour.title: Regression and Content Guarantees
tour.description: Finish with tests that connect the catalog, kit and delivery pieces introduced earlier. They check metadata and source handling, LinkedIn content, Desk Pet prompt parity and assets, plus follow-up suppression and scheduling rules, making the intended boundaries concrete.
